text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a scheduled weighted trickle for release v2026.03.21-r2 tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. target route: /chat/generate. will do 5% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% every 10m, health gate between steps.
devon: ack. can you paste the exact health gates? latency + error thresholds?
maya: gate = 95th latency < 220ms (prod baseline ~200ms) AND 5xx rate < 0.2% AND token-per-request cost variance < 10% vs baseline. if any fail, we hold and run a 10m extended probe or rollback depending on severity.
jen: double-checking: are we pinning model version at router level or LB-level split? need to ensure client sticky sessions don't hit mixed versions.
maya: router-level weighted-routes by backend-tag. we'll pin session cookies for new cohort if session-affinity present. no global session change otherwise.
sre-bot: runbook check: reroute playbook: /runbooks/deploy-weighted-trickle.md - confirmed. automated rollback enabled.
leo: are we warming the edge pools first? last time we saw cold GPU latencies when traffic jumped above 30%.
maya: yes — warmup window enabled 15m before first traffic. warmup preloads kv-cache and runs synthetic probes at 5tps.
deploy-bot: deploy start: v2026.03.21-r2 -> router-prod (route=/chat/generate). preflight ok. warming started.
devon: rolling metric watch: I'll own latency and 5xx. jen you own correctness/regression signals (eval harness). leo keep an eye on edge warmups and capacity spikes.
jen: will run smoke eval set (10 prompts) at each step and post JSON diff. if hallucination rise > 2% or rouge drops, we abort.
maya: agreed. adding extra guard: if any external customer in vip list sees >0.5% degraded responses we abort immediately.
deploy-bot: 02:00 UTC — step 1: 5% traffic applied. health: latency 198ms p95, 5xx 0.03%, eval pass.
devon: monitoring — looks clean so far. no anomalies in the first 3m. metrics dashboard pinned: https://console/redwood/dashboards/deploy-2112345678
leo: edge pool warm counters: 90% warmed. no GC spikes.
jen: smoke eval diffs: negligible. sample outputs look ok.
deploy-bot: 02:10 UTC — step 2: 10% traffic applied. health: latency 205ms p95, 5xx 0.06%, eval pass.
devon: p95 rising but within gate. continuing.
maya: reminder — we have 2-minute manual hold between steps if anyone wants to pause.
leo: small burst on one EU node, autoscaler scaled one extra card. verify KV cache hit ratios?
devon: kv cache hit still ~88%, good.
deploy-bot: 02:20 UTC — step 3: 25% traffic applied. health: latency 230ms p95, 5xx 0.25%, evals show slight diffs.
jen: hitting our latency gate and 5xx just crossed threshold (0.25% > 0.2%). I recommend hold and run extended probe.
maya: hold in place. hold reason: p95 + 5xx breach. extending probe 10m. notifying merchants.
leo: looking at logs — spike concentrated on a particular instance pool in eu-west-1; errors are timeouts during KV cache miss path.
devon: can we route EU traffic to alternate pool temporarily (regional fallback) and continue ramp for global?
maya: yes but prefer not to change routing mid-run unless we know it's safe. alternative: drop EU subset to pre-step weight and continue global run?
jen: prefer rollback whole release for now — correctness matters more for chat. but I'm ok with partial rollback to keep global healthy if we can isolate quickly.
leo: I can push a targeted routing shift: reduce eu-west-1 weight by 60% for this route while keeping others unchanged. takes ~30s to propagate.
maya: do it. record decision: partial regional fallback to eu-west-1 pool. will keep step at 25% until probe finishes.
deploy-bot: routing adjustment applied: eu-west-1 weight -60% for route /chat/generate.
devon: metrics after reroute: p95 down to 208ms, 5xx 0.09%. nice.
jen: re-run smoke evals — samples look clean now. no new regressions.
maya: good. proceed to step 4 in 2m if no regress.
deploy-bot: 02:40 UTC — step 4: 50% traffic applied (global). health: latency 212ms p95, 5xx 0.11%, eval pass.
devon: watch for cost delta; token-per-request slightly higher (6%) on this step — within our 10% guard.
leo: note: eu-west still underweighted by routing change; should we reintroduce capacity or keep it?
maya: keep the routing override until end of the release window. file a follow-up to investigate eu-west cache miss root cause.
jen: final step to 100% in 10m if we stay green. I will kick off a larger eval set at 50% (100 prompts).
jen: evals running... 95/100 pass, 3 borderline answers flagged for small formatting change. no hallucination increase.
maya: unless someone shouts, we go to 100% at 02:50 UTC. any objections?
devon: no objections.
leo: no objections. I pulled a short postmortem ticket for eu-west: PM-1489.
deploy-bot: 02:50 UTC — step 5: 100% traffic applied. health: latency 210ms p95, 5xx 0.08%. deployment complete.
maya: thanks all. post-deploy checklist: promote release notes to product, tag commit in repo, schedule 24h increased retention for trace logs, and follow-up root cause on eu-west.
devon: promoted release to release-notes channel. metrics will be in high-resolution for 1h.
jen: adding eval summary to the release ticket.
leo: eu-west TODO: investigate cache eviction pattern, prepare hotfix if we see re-occurrence.
sre-bot: deploy finished no rollback. automated rollback window closed.
maya: Great run. note for next time: consider 7.5% increments to smooth p95 spike. also add regional preflight test to catch eu-specific cache miss earlier. :thumbsup:
